\begin{document}
At temperature $T>0$ the occupations of $\pm\epsilon$ add up to one,
\begin{equation}
\frac{1}{e^{\epsilon/T}+1} + \frac{1}{e^{-\epsilon/T}+1} = 1 .
\label{eq:ph}
\end{equation}
For symmetric coupling the transmission $T(\omega)$ reaches unity on resonance,
\begin{equation}
T(\epsilon_d) = 1 .
\label{eq:res}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
